title: Do not apply serialization temporal formats to validation JSON schemas
answers: Why does model_json_schema(mode='validation') output type number for datetime when ser_json_temporal is configured?
Why does validation JSON schema say number for timedelta when ser_json_timedelta is float?
How to prevent serialization temporal format settings from changing validation schemas in GenerateJsonSchema?
body:
Symptom: Validation JSON schema for datetime, date, time, or timedelta indicates 'type': 'number' instead of 'string' when ser_json_temporal or ser_json_timedelta is configured.
Root cause: pydantic/json_schema.py:GenerateJsonSchema._common_temporal_schema inspected temporal serialization formats without verifying self.mode == 'serialization'.
Fix pattern: Gate serialization-specific schema type overrides behind a self.mode == 'serialization' check.
Constraints: Applies when serializer configurations alter output format/type while validation still accepts standard representations (e.g. ISO 8601 strings).
applies: Generating validation vs serialization JSON schemas for temporal fields in GenerateJsonSchema
